projects/tokenrouter.md: Built an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway that converts between provider protocols, routes by priority and weight with failure-aware retries, and reserves and settles token quotas concurrency-safely.
- **Stack:** Go, React, OpenAI/Anthropic/Google APIs, GORM, Redis, Casbin, Docker

- Hardened relay and control planes with SSRF-safe outbound dialing, JWT refresh rotation with replay detection, Casbin RBAC, and WebAuthn/TOTP step-up verification; validated quota accounting under race-condition tests.
User and API-token quota holds are paired in one database transaction. Settlement and refunds are idempotent, and durable reservation records keep failed operations available for reconciliation.
The test suites cover atomic settlement, repeated settlement and refunds, rollback on failure, and concurrent reservations that cannot overspend.
projects/mobileid.md: Built a Django/Vue identity platform for PDF417 barcode generation, profile management, and device-aware sessions on PostgreSQL and DynamoDB.
- **Stack:** Python, Django, Vue, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Docker, GitHub Actions
- Layered authentication defenses: HTTP-only cookie JWTs, CSRF validation, refresh-token rotation and blacklisting, immediate session revocation, and Argon2 hashing.
- Gated CI on Bandit, Safety, Trivy, and dependency audits at a 70% coverage floor, plus Playwright E2E suites and Docker/Vite build validation.
Cookie-based JWT authentication combines refresh-token blacklisting with access-session revocation checks on subsequent API requests. Cookie-authenticated writes also require CSRF validation.

Tests cover device listing, revoking one or all other devices, rejection of revoked access tokens, and CSRF enforcement. CI configures a 70% backend coverage floor alongside security checks and Playwright suites.
